fine_lines.title: should vs ought to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الاثنان بمعنى «ينبغي» لإعطاء نصيحة، والمعنى تقريبًا واحد. should أكثر شيوعًا وبدون to: You should be careful. أما ought to فلها to دائمًا: You ought to buy the app. وفي النفي والسؤال نستخدم should غالبًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both give advice and mean almost the same. should is more common and has no 'to': You should be careful. ought to always has 'to': You ought to buy the app. For negatives and questions, use should.

examples.sentence: You ought to see a doctor.
You shouldn't play games on the street.

fine_lines.title: watch out vs look out
fine_lines.explanation_ar: التعبيران بنفس المعنى: «انتبه!» تحذير سريع من خطر. Anna تقول Watch out! وفي الدرس التالي يقول Dan: Look out!
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean 'Be careful! There is danger!' Anna says 'Watch out!' and Dan later says 'Look out!'

expressions.example: Watch out! The stairs are wet.

grammar.title: should / ought to for advice
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) should + الفعل الأصلي لإعطاء النصيحة: You should be careful. 2) لا نضيف s ولا to بعد should: She should rest. 3) ought to + الفعل الأصلي بنفس المعنى: You ought to buy the app. 4) النفي: shouldn't: You shouldn't run here. 5) السؤال: Should I ...?
grammar.explanation_en: 1) should + base verb gives advice: You should be careful. 2) No -s and no 'to' after should: She should rest. 3) ought to + base verb has the same meaning. 4) Negative: shouldn't. 5) Question: Should I ...?
examples: You ought to buy the app.
You shouldn't play on the street.

grammar.title: Simple past negative: didn't + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) لنفي الماضي نستخدم didn't (did not) + الفعل الأصلي: I didn't see you. 2) لا نستخدم الماضي بعد didn't: (didn't saw خطأ). 3) في الدرس أيضًا أفعال ماضية: caught, won, signed, wrote.
grammar.explanation_en: 1) To make the past negative, use didn't (did not) + base verb: I didn't see you. 2) Don't use the past form after didn't (not 'didn't saw'). 3) Other past forms in the lesson: caught, won, signed, wrote.
examples: Jefferson signed the Declaration of Independence.
